label: Carbonate Field Test Kit
description: A small, portable kit used to detect the presence of calcium carbonate in rock matrix using a 10% Hydrochloric Acid (HCl) solution.

components.function: Used to stop the reaction and clean the rock surface after testing.

game_mechanics.effervescence_check: Applying acid to Limestone/Calcite triggers an 'Active Fizz' (CO2 release). Siliceous rocks (Sandstone/Chert) show no reaction.
game_mechanics.lab_strategy_unlock: Successful 'Fizz' result unlocks the 'Acid Preparation' minigame in the Lab phase.
